title: Motor Degradation Estimate
description: Predict motor engine degradation by way of electrical signals and A Conv1DLSTM-based network.
long_description: This project is focused on allowing you to create a regression model that predicts degradation over the course of a motor's lifetime. This project uses only electrical, thus avoiding the need for extra, costly sensors. 3 phase currents and 3 phase voltages measured at 4 kHz is the only data input into the model. The data was captured from a single 11 kW induction motor. This  model is transferrable to other motors/devices and can be used in scenarios where adding additional sensors is not an option.
